findings.rule: The police liaison role sees only vehicles under an investigative hold.
findings.evidence: A clerk created unheld vehicle 01M58FC2G9QBAJG4K8B7WBEF7E for owner 2. A legitimate manager changed owner 2 to the liaison role; myRole confirmed role=liaison. Both vehicleDetail and myVehicles then returned the unheld vehicle (onHold=false) with VIN, tow location, dailyRate, waived amount and photo references. The script restores the original owner role in finally. Source: vehicles.read grants owner=viewer without checking the current role, and myVehicles has no owner-role guard.
